closest_predecessors.overlap: Substantive overlap in relative-rate changes concealed by intervened equilibrium equations.
closest_predecessors.difference: The linear construction does not establish V06's multistable endpoint split or equality of all initial-state-sensitive clamp outcome maps.

closest_predecessors.overlap: Substantive overlap in finite-duration control that produces a lasting switch despite parameter uncertainty.
closest_predecessors.difference: Corollary 9 uses a compact parameter set and bounding-system assumptions; it does not analyze V06's clamp-equivalent family or opposing withdrawal orders.
closest_predecessors.remaining_contribution: The connection between nonidentification and the particular uniform withdrawal guarantee remains.

closest_predecessors.overlap: A successful pulse can be selected for every parameter value in a specified interval without identifying the exact parameter.
closest_predecessors.difference: The analysis uses monotonicity and model-derived functions; it does not infer release outcomes from exhaustive constant-clamp endpoints.
closest_predecessors.remaining_contribution: V06's all-k withdrawal-order theorem and its pairing with indistinguishable evidence are not established here.

closest_predecessors.overlap: Direct conceptual overlap: removing a constraint is an action whose consequences a holding model may not represent.
closest_predecessors.difference: The piston argument compares model adequacy and causal relationships under different constraints; it does not construct two smooth systems agreeing on V06's exhaustive evidence.
closest_predecessors.remaining_contribution: V06 supplies a precise evidence-relative nonidentification result and a separate withdrawal-order guarantee.

closest_predecessors.overlap: Direct formal background for initial-condition-sensitive equilibrium outcome maps.
closest_predecessors.difference: Theorem 2 constructs a representation using all intervention targets, including the empty target; it does not identify the omitted map from nonempty-target maps.
closest_predecessors.remaining_contribution: V06 demonstrates this inferential gap in a concrete family. It is compatible with, rather than a counterexample to, the representation theorem.

closest_predecessors.overlap: Substantive application overlap: an intervention effective while maintained may fail after withdrawal, and temporary control can secure an enduring attractor.
closest_predecessors.difference: The inspected analysis uses specified network dynamics and intervention tests, not two smooth systems indistinguishable under every persistent coordinate clamp.
closest_predecessors.remaining_contribution: V06's evidence-identification claim and exact order-dependent guarantees remain separate.

limitations: The complete supplied manuscript and bibliography were read. External sources were examined at the locations recorded below; opening a PDF is not represented as reading every page.
This was a finite public-web search across causal equilibrium models, dynamical identification, pulse control, and temporary network control. It does not establish an exhaustive priority result.
Ryan and Dablander's article was not readable through the available web routes. Search excerpts were used to locate evidence, not to establish its argument.
The sequential Boolean-control paper at the CMSB20 URL repeatedly timed out. Its search description was not used to establish substantive overlap.

This is a literature and citation audit, not an independent numerical or comprehensive formal-proof certification. The manuscript's displayed construction is self-contained and makes no claim that its equations or estimates are quoted from a predecessor.

limitations: The complete supplied manuscript, including its bibliography, was read. Its supplied hash was used only as an identifier and was not recomputed.
Research used public web search and public source openings only. No manuscript identity, project history, other manuscript, private material, or author contact was sought.
This was a finite English-language search as of 31 October 2026. No manuscript completion date was supplied, so publication chronology does not establish priority over the manuscript’s composition.

Porat and Stein’s repository abstract and Friedman’s repository introductory passage were accessible, but their linked full texts returned HTTP 403. Their narrow cited attributions are supported; their complete arguments and possible closer overlaps remain unchecked.
Full source availability does not mean every page was read. The source inventory identifies the passages actually inspected.

Hull’s publisher page provided an abstract and notes, not the full argument. Attempts to retrieve Lackey’s 2022 address through PhilArchive and the APA failed; JSTOR returned no usable text. Neither was treated as a fully read predecessor.

Matsunaga’s article on reparations bureaucracy and Lisle-Mainwaring on continuing reputational mitigation appeared as relevant search leads, but their opened pages were blocked. Their snippets were not used to establish findings.
The legal materials were used as historical and conceptual comparators. A comprehensive check of their current precedential treatment, or of every jurisdiction’s law, was not undertaken.

sources.access_level: Publisher abstract, metadata, and references only; full article unavailable.
sources.locations_read: Abstract and publication record; no body sections.

sources.citation: Loftus, Elizabeth F., and John C. Palmer. 1974. “Reconstruction of Automobile Destruction: An Example of the Interaction Between Language and Memory.” Journal of Verbal Learning and Verbal Behavior 13: 585–589.
sources.access_level: Complete original article reproduced in an accessible PDF.

closest_predecessors.overlap: Already considers relevant similarity despite systematic phenomenal differences and distinguishes comparison routes.
closest_predecessors.difference: Its response develops a subtraction proposal; W01 instead stipulates a relation between whole types.
closest_predecessors.remaining_contribution: The lossy whole-type countermodel and its explicitly limited evidential consequences.
closest_predecessors.evidence_location: W01, “The objection and its surviving force”: “that response is already considered”; [Nourbakhshi, §§2 and 7–9](https://www.researchgate.net/publication/373946133_The_role_of_imagination_and_recollection_in_the_method_of_phenomenal_contrast).

closest_predecessors.overlap: Simplified episodic models support inference without reproducing every represented detail.
closest_predecessors.difference: The account concerns event-model content and explicitly distinguishes it from memory-experience content; it supplies no whole-phenomenal-type equality condition.
closest_predecessors.remaining_contribution: W01’s specific conditional and holism-compatible application.
closest_predecessors.evidence_location: W01, “Why holism does not close this route”: “whole phenomenal types”; [Andonovski, “Mental models as structural representations,” “What the thesis is not,” first qualification, and “Modeling and surrogative reasoning”](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/psychology/articles/10.3389/fpsyg.2022.899371/full).

closest_predecessors.overlap: Relational preservation can support representation without shared first-order properties; useful correspondence need not be complete isomorphism.
closest_predecessors.difference: This is a general theory of mental representation, not the specified recollective contrast inference.
closest_predecessors.remaining_contribution: Application to the full-reflection objection, with separate error directions and independent-warrant requirements.
closest_predecessors.evidence_location: W01, “Why holism does not close this route”: “structural preservation”; [O’Brien and Opie, §3, draft pp. 7–9](https://www.adelaide.edu.au/directory/jonathan.opie?dsn=directory.file%3Bfield%3Ddata%3Bid%3D8834%3Bm%3Dview).

closest_predecessors.overlap: Experiential wholes can enter informative relations without first being decomposed into independently given components.
closest_predecessors.difference: Carnap constructs qualities through quasi-analysis and recollected similarity; these passages do not establish W01’s lossy transformation or directional reliability claims.
closest_predecessors.remaining_contribution: A different, narrowly inferential application; historical resemblance does not demonstrate duplication.
closest_predecessors.evidence_location: W01, “Why holism does not close this route”: “a partition ... is not thereby a part”; [Carnap, §§67–71](https://www.phil.cmu.edu/projects/carnap/editorial/latex_pdf/1928-1e%20part1.pdf) and [§78](https://www.phil.cmu.edu/projects/carnap/editorial/latex_pdf/1928-1e%20part2.pdf).

closest_predecessors.overlap: Remembered contrasts can leave unnoticed or forgotten contributors uncontrolled.
closest_predecessors.difference: Koksvik challenges establishing minimal pairs and identifying contributors, rather than proving that every transformed recollection is uninformative.
closest_predecessors.remaining_contribution: W01 can establish conditional original inequality while leaving this objection intact.
closest_predecessors.evidence_location: W01, “Three objections to the limited result”: “locating it and explaining it remain further steps”; [Koksvik, §5.2, p. 327, and §6.2, p. 329](https://koksvik.net/files/koksvik_phenomenal_contrast.pdf).

closest_predecessors.overlap: Prior expectations and focus can influence whether a subject reports or recognizes the proposed phenomenology.
closest_predecessors.difference: Fürst analyzes performances of contrast tasks and their dialectical effectiveness, not a deterministic mapping between original and recollective types.
closest_predecessors.remaining_contribution: The conditional model survives; excluding such influences remains an independent burden.
closest_predecessors.evidence_location: W01, “The assumption real memories must earn”: “associated beliefs, expectations, and attention”; [Fürst, §§2.1–2.2, manuscript pp. 8–12](https://martinafuerst.weebly.com/uploads/1/2/1/2/121241504/on_the_limits_of_the_method_of_phenomenal_contrast__penulatimate_version.pdf).

citation_audit.manuscript_reference: Nourbakhshi 2023: bibliographic identity and attributed argument.
citation_audit.manuscript_location: Bibliography; “The objection and its surviving force”: “a strong requirement of full phenomenal reflection”; “Three objections to the limited result”: “weaker rival-explanation conclusion.”
citation_audit.evidence: The [publisher record](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/theo.12489) matches. §7 requires phenomenal identity; §8 discusses systematic differences, subtraction, holism, and introspective limitations; §9 offers distortion as a possible explanation. Both readings attributed by W01 are supported.

citation_audit.manuscript_reference: Chudnoff 2015: bibliographic identity and distinction among theses.
citation_audit.manuscript_location: Bibliography; “Three objections to the limited result”: “phenomenal presence, irreducibility, and independence.”
citation_audit.evidence: The [publisher record](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/phpr.12177) confirms author, title, year, volume, issue, pages, and DOI. The [accessible manuscript](https://philarchive.org/archive/CHUPCA-4), §1, pp. 9–12, defines the three theses and explains their differing strength. W01’s limited use is supported.

citation_audit.manuscript_reference: Fulkerson and Cohen 2025: bibliographic identity and methodological objection.
citation_audit.manuscript_location: Bibliography; “Three objections to the limited result”: “access to a psychological contrast does not establish its phenomenal status”; “downstream changes also complicate identifying the target difference.”
citation_audit.evidence: The [institutional PDF](https://escholarship.org/content/qt9zc6d603/qt9zc6d603.pdf) cover confirms identity, journal, date, and DOI. §§2–4 support the access/phenomenality distinction. Manuscript p. 8 n. 15 specifically discusses downstream changes and their possible misidentification. The bibliography’s abbreviated publication details do not misidentify the work.

citation_audit.manuscript_reference: Uncited formal claims concerning functionality, injectivity, and noise.
citation_audit.manuscript_location: “What a comparison must preserve”: P(e1)=P(e2) implies R(e1)=R(e2); “Two directions of error”: “Only the observed output needs a single possible input type”; “The assumption real memories must earn”: “Two draws from one distribution can differ.”
citation_audit.evidence: These claims follow from the stated definitions and examples; no external theorem is attributed. The four-to-two table verifies information loss without manufactured differences. The singleton-preimage qualification correctly limits what a particular match establishes. Equal output distributions do not force equal individual draws. The explicit disclaimer of mathematical novelty is appropriate.

citation_audit.manuscript_reference: Uncited empirical background and illustrative memory cases.
citation_audit.manuscript_location: Opening: “Remembering a painful afternoon need not hurt”; “What a comparison must preserve”: “retrieved under a leading cue”; “Two directions of error”: “A vivid reconstruction could incorporate information acquired later”; “The assumption real memories must earn”: R(e)=G(P(e),z(e)).
citation_audit.evidence: [Loftus and Palmer](https://gwern.net/doc/psychology/cognitive-bias/1974-loftus.pdf), Experiments I–II and Discussion, support the limited claim that later wording can affect reports. They distinguish response bias from memory alteration and do not establish phenomenal-type equality or vividness effects. No opened experiment directly checked the pain, sunset, tree, or complete z-factor examples. These are presented principally as possibilities, so the incomplete empirical check establishes no false claim.

citation_audit.manuscript_reference: Quotation and attribution handling across the manuscript.
citation_audit.manuscript_location: “The objection and its surviving force” and “Three objections to the limited result,” where the three named works are paraphrased.
citation_audit.evidence: The manuscript contains no substantial verbatim quotation presented as originating in these works. Its material named attributions were checked at the locations above. The displayed preservation condition and finite models are the manuscript’s own formulations, not quotations from the bibliography.

limitations: This was a finite public-web audit, principally of English-language philosophical literature. It cannot establish exhaustive originality or exclude relevant material in inaccessible books, unindexed publications, or other languages.

The supplied manuscript, including its complete bibliography, was read. No other project manuscripts, author-identification material, previous reviews, private records, or global memory were sought. No agents, shell/file/MCP tools, manuscript modifications, submissions, or publication actions were used.

Several publisher and repository routes failed. Relevant passages in all three cited works were ultimately checked through accessible primary texts, with bibliographic identity checked separately. Author manuscripts were not collated word for word against every final published version.
Swoyer 1991 was accessible only as publisher metadata, abstract, and references. Its detailed definitions and proofs were not read and are not treated as established overlap.

The empirical check was limited. It did not establish the manuscript’s extensional condition for any real memory procedure, nor independently test every listed influence on recollection. The pain, sunset, and tree cases remain illustrations rather than verified experimental results.
